title: Gravitational formulation of stress-tensor deformed field theories
summary: Stress-tensor deformations suggest a geometric origin of emergent gravity but are typically non-local for $d>2$. We couple a seed QFT to Einstein gravity with deformation parameter $λ$ and evaluate the gravitational path integral at the metric saddle. Around a fixed reference background, the leading deformation is universal: a bilocal term quadratic in the stress tensor with kernel set by the graviton Green's function, plus a systematic higher-order expansion.
